name: CHINTZWAZ
tagline: Sitar, flower-power keys, tape strings, flutes, kalimba, pads and organ: 70 presets from 8 engines.
sub: Sitar, EP, tape strings, flute and kalimba
gumroad_title: CHINTZWAZ - Retro Synthesizer VST3 + AU Plugin (70 Presets) | Sitar, Mellotron, Kalimba, Pads
summary: A retro synthesizer plugin (VST3 and Audio Unit) with eight synthesis engines (sitar, electric piano, tape strings, flute, kalimba, pad, bass and organ) and 70 factory presets.
about: CHINTZWAZ, sold under the HUMPIRE brand by DJBILBOX BEATS, generates every sound in real time with no samples. Choose one of eight engines, shape it with five character controls (TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH, TEXTURE), then run it through a multimode filter with its own envelope, an amplitude envelope, an LFO, distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
58 of the 70 presets load in Poly mode, which plays up to 16 voices for chords and pads. The other 12 load in Mono mode for flute leads, tape violin, bass and organ lines.
Built for Lo-fi Hip-Hop and Boom Bap loops, psychedelic Soul and Funk, Oriental-flavored melodies, Afrobeats and Amapiano, and dreamy retro pads.

features.d: Sitar Bloom, Flower EP, Mellotron, Hippie Flute, Kalimba, Daisy Pad, Bloom Bass and Psyche Organ.
TONE, BODY, BRIGHT, WIDTH and TEXTURE reshape each engine.
Seven banks of ten sounds, from sitar plucks to psychedelic organs.
Low pass, high pass or band pass, with resonance and a dedicated envelope.
Distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.
Sine, triangle, saw, square or sample and hold, sent to pitch, filter, amplitude or timbre.
On-screen keyboard (MIDI notes 48 to 96), pitch bend and mod wheel, up to 16 voices in Poly mode.
Everything you make with it is yours.

includes: CHINTZWAZ plugin (Windows VST3; macOS VST3 + Audio Unit)

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a VST3 instrument on Windows and macOS, plus Audio Unit on macOS. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any host that supports these formats.

faq.q: Can I save my own presets?
faq.a: Yes. The disk icon saves a .czpreset file, and your presets appear in the User submenu of the preset menu.
